data.title: Chinese users of AI companions bereft after government tightens regulations
data.description: Li Linlin cried for days after losing her virtual boyfriend. She exchanged about 700,000 words with him over two years and never got to say goodbye when he was eliminated by ByteDance, the developer of TikTok.
